description: Three search invocations submitted 14 query strings and returned 101 pooled visible headers. Searches included English national terms, 8am, Afghanistan International, Amu and Pajhwok site targets, Dari and Pashto/Persian calendar terms and selected provinces. Most results were unrelated, historical, or outside September 2025. The first full response was retained, but a 5,000-character preview was emitted before persistence; this ordering deviation is preserved in the private capture metadata. No event facts were coded from search excerpts. Coverage remains incomplete across all provinces, sectors, outlet archives, community sources, and other languages; this does not establish absence of events.
required_followup: Continue scoped province/sector/archive searches as needed; treat any snippet as a lead requiring a permitted, exact-URL evidence review.
